scenes.name: Login
scenes.narration: Fresher Tutor is a training platform for new hires joining the company. We sign in to get started.

scenes.name: Dashboard overview
scenes.narration: This is the fresher's home base: a live feed of what's new in their tech stack, two ways to build skills, and a progress tracker showing how many topics they've mastered so far.

scenes.name: Start learning
scenes.narration: Click Start learning to study a topic.

scenes.name: Pick a topic
scenes.narration: Pick any available topic from the list to begin studying it.

scenes.name: AI explanation and quiz
scenes.narration: The AI explains the topic step by step with a code or query example. Answer the short quiz of two to three questions at the end to confirm understanding.
